sessionReminders._comment: Minutes after which an open session asks "still going?" (norms: bottle feeds 15-30 min, nursing 10-45 min, newborn naps up to ~3 h; sleep only for naps started in the day). Used by ReminderPlanner.

event_type.instructions: Which baby log entry does the parent's sentence describe?

category.instructions: Which kind of baby log entry is the parent reporting?

phase.instructions: Is it starting, switching, finishing, or a complete entry logged afterwards?

start.description: starting, beginning, falling asleep, going down

finish.description: finished, done, ended, waking up: what was going on just ended

single.description: a feed told after it was over (had a bottle an hour ago, drank half), logged as one entry

amount.instructions: How much of the bottle did the baby drink?

full.description: drank all of it, finished the whole bottle

not_stated.description: amount not mentioned; done or all done alone does not say how much

breast_milk.description: breast milk, pumped milk, expressed milk

diaper_kind.instructions: What kind of diaper was it?

solids_amount.instructions: How much solid food did the baby eat?

taste.description: just a taste, a bite or two

now.description: just now, right now, no time mentioned
